fullPassage: One valuable technique for getting out of helplessness, depression, and situations which are predominantly being run by the thought, "I can't," is to choose to be with other persons who have resolved the problem with which we struggle. This is one of the great powers of self-help groups. When we are in a negative state, we have given a lot of energy to negative thought forms, and the positive thought forms are weak. Those who are in a higher vibration are free of the energy from their negative thoughts and have energized positive thought forms. Merely to be in their presence is beneficial. In some self-help groups, this is called "hanging out with the winners." The benefit here is on the psychic level of consciousness, and there is a transfer of positive energy and relighting of one's own latent positive thought forms.

④ presence(존재/있음): 그 자리에 있음을 뜻해 정의와 다름
det.tip: '깨어서 인식하는 상태'라는 정의의 핵심을 파악한다.

questions.passage: When we are in a negative state, we have given a lot of energy to negative thought forms, and the positive thought forms are weak. Those who are in a higher vibration are free of the energy from their negative thoughts and have __________ (energize) positive thought forms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 영어로 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: have 뒤에서 현재완료를 이루므로 과거분사 energized가 되어야 한다.
det.analysis: 동사 energize를 have와 함께 현재완료(have energized)로 쓰기 위해 과거분사 energized로 변형한다.
det.tip: have + 과거분사(현재완료) 구조를 확인한다.

questions.passage: One valuable technique for getting out of helplessness, depression, and situations which are __________ (predominant) being run by the thought, "I can't," is to choose to be with other persons who have resolved the problem with which we struggle. This is one of the great powers of self-help groups.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 영어로 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: 동사(being run)를 수식하므로 형용사 predominant를 부사 predominantly로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: 형용사 predominant가 동사구 being run을 수식하려면 부사 predominantly로 변형해야 한다.
det.tip: 동사를 수식하는 자리에는 부사가 온다.

questions.passage: One valuable technique for getting out of helplessness, depression, and situations which are predominantly being run by the thought, "I can't," is to choose to be with other persons who have resolved the problem with which we struggle. This is one of the great powers of self-help groups. When we are in a negative state, we have given __________ to negative thought forms, and the positive thought forms are weak. Those who are in a higher vibration are free of the energy from their negative thoughts and have energized positive thought forms. Merely to be in their presence is beneficial. In some self-help groups, this is called "hanging out with the winners." The benefit here is on the psychic level of consciousness, and there is a transfer of positive energy and relighting of one's own latent positive thought forms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 부정적 상태에서 우리는 부정적 사고 형태에 '많은 에너지(a lot of energy)'를 준다.
det.analysis:
① a small amount of trust(적은 신뢰): 에너지의 양을 다루는 맥락과 무관
② a great sense of duty(강한 의무감): 문맥과 무관
③ a clear sign of doubt(분명한 의심의 신호): 문맥과 무관
④ a lot of energy(많은 에너지) ←정답: 부정적 사고에 많은 에너지를 쏟아 긍정적 사고가 약해짐
det.tip: 이어지는 '긍정적 사고가 약하다'와의 인과 관계를 파악한다.

det.korean: 높은 진동의 사람과 함께하면 '긍정 에너지(positive energy)'의 전달이 일어난다.
det.analysis:
